results.title: Simpson Manufacturing Co., Inc. (SSD)
results.snippet: Simpson Manufacturing Co. (Simpson Strong-Tie) is a Pleasanton, California maker of structural connectors and anchors for wood, concrete, and steel construction.

results.title: Simpson Manufacturing Co., Inc. (Simpson Strong-Tie)
results.snippet: Its wood-construction line covers connectors, truss plates, fasteners, and lateral-force resisting systems. For concrete and masonry, it offers mechanical and adhesive anchors and repair materials.

results.title: What is Simpson Manufacturing?
results.snippet: Products include holddowns, truss connector plates, nails, screws, fasteners, screw fastening systems, pre-fabricated steel and wood shearwalls, anchor tiedown systems, adhesives, mechanical anchors, carbide drill bits.

results.title: about us
results.snippet: Its anchors are designed to install easily and securely into a variety of base materials — from concrete and brick to hollow and grouted CMU.

results.title: company profiles.simpson strong tie company inc.
results.snippet: The company sells through distributors, retailers, and professional users such as contractors and engineers. Its markets are residential, commercial, and industrial construction, plus DIY.

results.title: Simpson Manufacturing Company
results.snippet: Its origins date to 1956 in California, when it began manufacturing engineered structural connectors for timber-framed construction.
